reviewMethod: Independent author compared every owned English and Vietnamese string against its exact canonical Japanese collectTranslatableUnits entry; corrected the four bounded issues recorded below and reread corrected strings. No other locale-pair files or prior pair translations were read.
checks: Full paragraphs, titles, prompts, key terms and both illustration alt texts translated without summaries.
Distinct compression/crimp tools, terminal/device sides, sleeves/pin terminals and main/branch wires retained.
Wire compatibility, stripping extent, independent insulation checks and product-specific conditions retained.
COS changeover destination and operation-permission limits retained; self-amalgamating does not imply universal waterproofing/voltage suitability.
Earth electrode versus rod, component connection versus system performance and separate installation/measurement stages retained.
Handhole position versus interior/entry checks, bellmouth local protection versus route-wide conditions and draw wire versus main installation/testing retained.
Special fittings/joints, horizontal versus vertical adjustments, mechanical retention versus electrical continuity and narrowly scoped omission of bonding wire retained.
Channel support versus conductor connections, raceway fixture support versus power wiring, suspension versus sway restraint and upper-to-lower support paths retained.
Fitting/model delivery versus site compatibility, two nuts versus established locking arrangement, saddles versus conduit connectors and permission versus terminology/appearance retained.
No source Japanese changed; no new technical operation, law, value, torque, angle, measurement or test method introduced.

corrections.before: Ví dụ, khi bảng vật liệu ghi đầu cốt còn bảng dụng cụ ghi dụng cụ nén, thứ thứ nhất là vật liệu dùng tại vị trí nối, thứ thứ hai là dụng cụ để gia công. Việc tên của chúng có trong hai bảng là thông tin chuẩn bị, không phải hồ sơ xác nhận đã nối xong.
corrections.after: Ví dụ, khi bảng vật liệu ghi đầu cốt còn bảng dụng cụ ghi dụng cụ nén, thứ nhất là vật liệu dùng tại vị trí nối, thứ hai là dụng cụ để gia công. Việc tên của chúng có trong hai bảng là thông tin chuẩn bị, không phải hồ sơ xác nhận đã nối xong.

corrections.before: An earth electrode is the part that electrically connects an earthing installation to the earth. An earth rod is one form of it and is also called an “earth rod” in Japanese-derived terminology. Because earth electrodes also take forms other than rods, “earth electrode” and “earth rod” do not have exactly the same scope.
corrections.after: An earth electrode is the part that electrically connects an earthing installation to the earth. An earth rod is one form of it and is also called アース棒 in Japanese. Because earth electrodes also take forms other than rods, “earth electrode” and “earth rod” do not have exactly the same scope.
corrections.reason: Preserved the alternate Japanese name アース棒 explicitly instead of redundantly repeating the English term; the electrode/rod scope remains distinct.

corrections.before: Double nuts are an anti-loosening arrangement using two nuts on the same bolt. They are used to address loosening caused by vibration and similar factors. Information that two nuts are present and confirmation that the anti-loosening arrangement is effective are separate things.
corrections.after: Double nuts are an anti-loosening arrangement using two nuts on the same bolt. They are used to address loosening caused by vibration and similar factors. Information that two nuts are present and confirmation that the anti-loosening arrangement has been properly established are separate things.
corrections.reason: Rendered 成立 as an established arrangement rather than implying measured effectiveness.
